concept.reason: Direct reference imagery and taxon-specific sources sufficient for original silhouette; no extra concept image.

scope: Original Glyptodon clavipes living reconstruction informed by Berlin skeletal-shell display photograph; NHM composite mount is supplementary genus-level comparison, not an exact single-specimen replica.

scientific_limits.en: Soft muzzle, skin, color, posture and dimensions are estimates. Berlin source is a processed photo montage of shell and skeleton, with corrections noted in file history; NHM mount explicitly combines several animals and casts. Neither is a scanned single living animal.
scientific_limits.zh: 软质吻部、皮肤、颜色、姿态和尺寸均为估计。柏林参考是经过处理的甲壳与骨架照片拼接图，文件历史中注明了修正；自然历史博物馆的装架标本明确由多个个体和翻模件组成。两者都不是对单一活体动物的扫描。

taxon_scope: Glyptodon clavipes, Berlin display attribution; not Doedicurus or Glyptotherium

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Artistic adult display envelope, not specimen measurement.

shape_requirements: Original high domed rigid shell plus short ring-armored tail must read together. Do not substitute long club tail of Doedicurus.
Deep oval carapace sits over four squat robust weight-bearing limbs, with small low projecting head and visible feet.
Tail stays short relative to dome, tapered with separate armored rings and modest scutes; no spiked mace.
Carapace is a rigid continuous dome, not flexible transverse armadillo bands. Small osteoderm facets are subordinate to silhouette.
construction_notes: Build dome and belly as body envelope, not hollow skeletal exhibit; create leg gaps and differentiated head/neck opening.
Sparse geometric osteoderm pattern suffices; avoid thousands of separate meshes or normal-map substitute for tail rings.
Neutral brown/gray coloring and walking stance are artistic. Original dome-tail shape gate is sufficient; no extra pose or ornament gate.

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: high domed rigid shell and a short ring-armored tail. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：高穹硬壳与短环甲尾。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block high domed rigid shell and a short ring-armored tail with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织高穹硬壳与短环甲尾；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded
gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
